faq.q: What does the name Aeneas mean?
faq.a: Aeneas means “Praised (proposed); etymology uncertain”.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aeneas?
faq.a: Aeneas is of Greek origin.

faq.q: What language does the name Aeneas come from?
faq.a: Aeneas is used in Ancient Greek, English, Latin.

faq.a: Aeneas is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aeneas written in Latin?
faq.a: Aeneas is written Aeneas in Latin script.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aeneas?
faq.a: The root of Aeneas is Greek Αἰνείας (Aineias); derivation uncertain - possibly from αἶνος (ainos) 'praise' or 'terrible tale'.

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aeneas?
faq.a: The derivation of Αἰνείας is uncertain. A common proposal links it to αἶνος (ainos), which can mean 'praise' or, in other contexts, 'a terrible tale'. No single derivation is established.

faq.q: Does Aeneas appear in the Bible?
faq.a: Yes. The personal name occurs in the New Testament (Acts 9:33-34).

faq.q: Is Aeneas a Biblical name?
faq.a: Yes — the personal name occurs in the Biblical text. The personal name occurs in the New Testament (Acts 9:33-34).

faq.q: Does Aeneas occur in the Old Testament?
faq.a: No — it is not attested in the Old Testament.

faq.q: Does Aeneas occur in the New Testament?
faq.a: Yes.

faq.q: Is Aeneas associated with a saint?
faq.a: No saint association is verified for the name Aeneas.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aeneas verified?
faq.a: The meaning “Praised (proposed); etymology uncertain” is supported by New Testament: a man at Lydda healed by Peter (Acts 9:33-34). Also the Trojan hero of Virgil's Aeneid. Confidence: MEDIUM.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aeneas?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aeneas total 45, reducing to 9. Number 9 is traditionally associated with compassion, idealism and completion. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aeneas?
faq.a: Variants and alternative forms include Aineias, Eneas.

faq.q: What is the transliteration of Aeneas?
faq.a: Aeneas is transliterated as Aineías.

faq.q: How many syllables does Aeneas have?
faq.a: Aeneas has 2 syllables.

faq.q: What are the spiritual connotations of Aeneas?
faq.a: Any spiritual significance attached to Aeneas is interpretive. Its documented core is the lexical meaning “Praised (proposed); etymology uncertain”, and readings built on that meaning are presented as tradition rather than as religious doctrine.

faq.q: Where is the name Aeneas used today?
faq.a: Aeneas circulates chiefly in Ancient Greek, English, Latin naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
